why: The launcher layer was written against a layout that no longer exists: WORMZ/, HYDRA/, HORUS/ and METAWORMS/ sat at the repo root, and $PERSEPHONE_ROOT pointed at a copy with bin/ inside it. Each entry below is measured, not guessed -- it was a basename-only match in the 2026-10-31 census, and declaring it upgrades that match from inference to fact. A declaration that matches no reference is reported as stale_alias, so this table cannot outlive the layout it describes. AZAZAEL_SRC was declared speculatively on the first run and reported stale; it was removed rather than left in as noise, which is the mechanism working.

deliberately_absent.ml_platforms/harness.py: two copies exist (HYDRA/ and ORCHESTRATION/); choosing one is a human decision, so it stays ambiguous and the candidates are printed
deliberately_absent.HYDRAMETA.py: src/HYDRAMETA.py and src/META/HYDRAMETA.py both exist; a launcher asking for it is ambiguous, not resolvable
deliberately_absent.AZAZAEL_INTEGRATION.py: no such file anywhere in the tree: a launcher bug, not a resolution gap
deliberately_absent.BIBL/bibl.py: the directory exists, the file is bibl_crawler.py: a launcher bug
deliberately_absent.METAWORMS/HYDROMETA.py: HYDRAMETA.py exists, HYDROMETA.py does not: a spelling bug in the launcher
